svg.aria-label: MuhOS (v0.1.0 released · open source). macOS-style desktop for Fedora on Hyprland, shipped as RPMs with a GDM session, a one-command installer and updates. Idle shell CPU cut ~9× in a VM. QML · Qt 6 · Quickshell · systemd.
